context: Whole family throws a surprise party for Sakura's book milestone; many voices.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さくら、本、出版おめでとう!
lines.en: Sakura — your book got published. Congratulations!
lines.style: Warm, genuine delight. Opens bright but not performative. Holds the congratulation with real care—the kind of warmth that comes from noticing someone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Surprised and touched, words catching slightly. Soft, searching tone like she's checking if this is real. Quick intake of breath before speaking.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 当たり前や、お祝いせなな!
lines.en: Of course we're celebrating! What else would we do?
lines.style: Loud, bright Kansai rhythm. Opens with full voice, generous energy. No question in it—a declaration. Bounces forward like she's gathering everyone with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Slow, measured Kansai cadence. Light emphasis on the second sentence—it's the real compliment. Warm, steady, the gravity of a grandfather who means what he says.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 長い道のり、お疲れさん。
lines.en: Long road. You did good work.
lines.style: Quiet, easy recognition. Slight Kansai lilt underneath. Speaks from experience—knows what it takes. Fond without being effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に編集、できて光栄でした。
lines.en: It was an honor to edit it with you.
lines.style: Soft, genuine humility. Hesitant opening—sincerity that's still learning how to say itself. Warm but careful, like offering something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Did you feel everyone's support the whole way?
lines.style: Tender, checking-in tone. Slow, gentle pace. Leans toward her with the question—genuinely wants to know if she felt held.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, slightly thick with emotion. Pauses before the word 'full'—emotion catching there. Quiet exhale at the end, like relief and gratitude in one breath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次の作品も、楽しみだね。
lines.en: I'm looking forward to what comes next.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging cadence. Speaks with the gentle certainty of someone who's seen her grow. Soft landing on 'next,' opening the door without pushing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こうやって、皆で祝えるって、ええな!
lines.en: This—being able to celebrate like this together. It's really something.
lines.style: Animated, full-throated Kansai warmth. Opens with energy, spreads out like she's embracing the whole room. Delighted in the togetherness itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Quiet, settled wisdom. Pauses slightly before 'treasure,' letting it land. Gentle Kansai rhythm. Few words, each one weighed with the sureness of someone who's lived long enough to know what matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 皆のおかげで、ここまで来れた。
lines.en: I wouldn't be here without all of you.
lines.style: Tender, vulnerable gratitude. Soft opening, slight tremor underneath. Looks around as she speaks, like she's naming each person. Trails slightly at the end, emotion still settling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Warm, rallying energy. Bright Kansai cadence, rising toward the count. Brings everyone together with his voice—inclusive, celebratory, the good host in him.
